problems.title_zh: 凯莱 (Cayley) 图和相关的问题
problems.title_en: Cayley graphs and related problems — Problem 3 (flag-transitive projective planes)
problems.question: Does every finite flag-transitive projective plane have to be Desarguesian? Equivalently, for n>8 with p=n^2+n+1 prime, show D={x in F_p*: x^(n+1)=1} is not a planar difference set.
problems.status: open; non-existence verified only for n < 2×10^11 (Thas–Zagier 2008); no later computational extension found (arXiv API, web incl. 2 zh queries, Semantic Scholar scan of all 25 citing papers; checked 2026-10-15)

key_sources.match: Thas–Zagier, JEMS 10 (2008) 173–190: special-prime criterion; 2^(n+1)≡1 test; n≡8 (mod 24); 'verifying the non-existence of non-Desarguesian flag-transitive finite projective planes for n < 2 × 10^11, or p < 4 × 10^22'
Xia, arXiv 1707.05486v7 (Jan 2023; Eur. J. Combin. per search snippet, venue page HTTP 403): new necessary conditions; cites only Feit's 14400008 range; no new computation

Li, PAMS 133 (2005) 31–41 (doi 10.1090/S0002-9939-04-07549-5), abstract: existence of a flag-transitive non-Desarguesian plane ⟺ existence of a very special arc-transitive normal Cayley graph of a dihedral group (full text HTTP 403)

problems.plausibility: A production range extension is plausible [INFERENCE]; independent exhaustive certification is not promised.
problems.notes: Recommended #1. Probes: TZ control list reproduced (even n < 3×10^8); sieve+2-test 5.3×10^7 class members/s on 4 threads at n≈2×10^11 → projected N ≈ 10^13–2×10^13 in ~4.5 h [INFERENCE]. Fits 4 threads/4 GB/1 GB. Problems 1–2 of the same article are research programmes (not precise). Literal 'diameter 2' is inconsistent for a bipartite Cayley graph; see catalog.md §c.1. Parent review: the literal graph assertion and its unspecified-S equivalence are both inconsistent; target only the geometric conjecture explicitly discussed in the article, using Kantor/Thas-Zagier. Main scan <=2.5h, full-residue checks, explicit imported premises; sampled checks cannot certify the whole range.

math-p0039.verbatim_zh: 最后, 令 G 是阶为 2p 的二面体群, 其中 p = n² + n + 1 是素数. 假定 n > 8, S 是由 G 中 n+1 个共轭对合组成的集合, 令 Cay(p)=Cay(G, S), 那么 Cay(p) 的直径至多为 3, 并且直径为 3 的图 Cay(p) 的存在性等价于 n 阶非 -Desarguesian 旗传递射影平面的存在性, 参见文献 [2]∼[4]. 后者是几何学中的一个重要问题, 其不存在性是几何学中一个著名的猜想. 因此, 我们提出 问题 3 证明对于所有的素数 p = n²+n+1 使得 n > 8, 图 Cay(p) 的直径等于 2.
math-p0039.formal_statement: Does every finite flag-transitive projective plane have to be Desarguesian? Equivalently, for n>8 with p=n^2+n+1 prime, show D={x in F_p*: x^(n+1)=1} is not a planar difference set.
math-p0039.literal_reading_issue: Cay(D_2p, reflections) is bipartite with parts of size p and valency n+1 < p, so its diameter is ≥ 3; 'diameter equals 2' cannot hold literally [INFERENCE]. The unspecified reflection set also breaks the printed graph/geometry equivalence; no unique silent repair is justified.
math-p0039.angle: Segmented sieve (drop n with a prime factor q ≤ 10^6, q < p, of p) + 128-bit Montgomery 2-test over n ≡ 8 (mod 24) in [2×10^11, N); survivors → primality, Feit divisor tests d^(n+1) ≡ 1. Main scan capped at2.5h within4h attack; every full-range claim is qualified by independently checked subsets.
math-p0039.deliverable: S(N) with N ≥ 2×10^12 (success), expected 10^13–2×10^13; code, per-block logs, survivor table.
math-p0039.verifier: Independent Python big-int pow implementation (no Montgomery, no sieve): all survivors, sampled sieve certificates, ≥10^6 random n per 10^12 block, one contiguous ≥10^8 sub-range hash-matched.
math-p0039.negative_control: Mutated exponent/modulus must break the known survivor list; sieve must keep n=8, 512 and drop 134217728; per-block coverage counts must equal the arithmetic count.
math-p0039.positive_control: All even n < 5×10^9 must give exactly 2, 8, 24, 90, 512, 134217728, 297474474 (probe reproduced this for n < 3×10^8).
math-p0039.kill_criteria: Control mismatch → no main run; hardened rate < 2×10^6 tests/s → stop and report weak; verifier disagreement invalidates a block; unresolved survivor reported, never claimed.
math-p0039.openai_math: no hit (local adc7f1241 docs + tex grep; remote listing 2026-10-15)
math-p0039.plausibility: high for N ≥ 2×10^12 [INFERENCE]; ~0 for a counterexample

math-p0424.kill_criteria: >10^-6 unresolved fraction, <2×10^6 n/s, or Gordon 2020 full text unavailable within 30 min.

math-p0104.verbatim_zh: 1974 年 Herzog 与 Schönheim 提出下述猜想：如果群 G 的有限个左陪集 a1G1, ···, akGk (k > 1) 构成 G 的不相交覆盖, 则诸指标 n1=[G:G1], ···, nk=[G:Gk] 不可能两两互异.
math-p0104.formal_statement: Every partition of a group into k > 1 left cosets of finite-index subgroups has two equal indices (reduces to finite groups).
math-p0104.baseline: Margolis–Schnabel (arXiv 1803.03569; BAG 2019): all groups of order < 1440; Garonzi–Margolis 2025: simple and symmetric groups. Covering systems: min-modulus record 42, bound 616000; odd covering lcm > 10000 (Lean, 2026).
math-p0104.angle: (A) extend HS to orders ≥ 1440 with GAP SmallGroups (install likely >1 GB: resource exception); (B) distinct covering with minimum modulus ≥ 43.
math-p0104.verifier: (A) independent SAT/ILP check of residual coset packings; (B) independent covering checker.
math-p0104.negative_control: (A) find genuine repeated-index partitions in S3/A4; (B) reject a 42-system with one class removed.
math-p0104.kill_criteria: (A) GAP not usable in 30 min or >10^7 candidate index multisets at order 1440; (B) no rebuilt 42-construction in 3 h.

requirements: Do not say the target is the book Cayley-graph form or follows from the book stated equivalence. Disclose both printed problems: reflection-generated dihedral Cayley graphs are bipartite with degree smaller than either part, so diameter two is impossible; and the unspecified reflection set breaks the printed equivalence (classical Singer difference sets give diameter-three graphs for Desarguesian planes). Credit the reduction to Kantor plus Thas-Zagier.

Declare every imported premise: Kantor 1987 (relies on the classification of finite simple groups), the Thas-Zagier special-prime reduction and base-two condition, Feit 8|n, and the derivation of n congruent to 2 modulo 3.
Before the main scan, add the proper-divisor guard q

Cross-checks at main-range modulus sizes must compare full 2^(n+1) mod p residues and actual sieve divisors, not only survivor flags. Any contiguous hash must include every n decision and residue. A uniform failing big-integer bug must not masquerade as no survivors.

A probable-prime test cannot eliminate a survivor. Each survivor needs an exact elimination reason, such as an explicit proper factor or a proved necessary-condition failure; otherwise list it as unresolved.
Cap the main production scan at about 2.5 hours. Report N only as the end of the last unbroken audited block.

Defensible success wording: Assuming the declared imported theorems, one production computation excluded all candidates for 200000000000<=n<N in the audited congruence class; independent arbitrary-precision checks covered only stated subsets. Therefore no non-Desarguesian flag-transitive plane of order less than N exists, conditional on those premises. Never say the extended range was independently certified, and keep the all-orders conjecture open.
